scenarios.name: Broad sell-off
scenarios.description: Hypothetical simultaneous decline across stocks and ETFs; not a historical event or forecast.

scenarios.name: Deep equity shock
scenarios.description: Hypothetical severe equity decline with a smaller ETF decline. ETF holdings are not classified by underlying exposure.

scenarios.name: Uniform decline
scenarios.description: Hypothetical equal decline for all holdings, irrespective of sector or ETF exposure.
